caption:
More trades isn't more MONEY. ⚠️

Three A+ setups, +4R before 11:00. Then boredom kicks in: 9 more trades, none of them in the plan, and the day closes at -2R. Your edge lives in a few setups. Every extra trade outside them is just paying the market back.

1️⃣ Set a maximum number of trades per day
2️⃣ Take only your A+ setups
3️⃣ Daily target hit? Close the platform
